sources: Hamro Patro (https://www.hamropatro.com/calendar/{year}/{month}/) - day data parsed from the JSON embedded in the page: tithiShort (displayed name), tithiShifted flag, panchanga.tithi/paksha (sunrise tithi), AD date, events
Ashesh Nepali Calendar (https://www.ashesh.com.np/nepali-calendar/?year={year}&month={month}) - per-day romanized tithi name and AD day, used as cross-check
nepalicalendar.rat32.com was attempted but is behind a bot-verification page and could not be read
notes: Scale: 'tithi' is 1-30 (1-15 shukla, 15=purnima; 16-30 krishna, 30=amavasya/aunsi). 'paksha_tithi' is 1-15 within the paksha. 'tithi'/'paksha'/'paksha_tithi'/'name_ne' are the tithi prevailing at SUNRISE as given by Hamro Patro's own panchanga data (panchanga.tithi is 0-based: 0-13 = pratipada..chaturdashi, 14 = purnima, 15 = aunsi; panchanga.paksha 0=shukla,1=krishna). 'hp_display_ne' is the name Hamro Patro actually prints in the calendar grid. On days flagged hp_tithi_shifted (a vriddhi/repeated sunrise tithi), Hamro Patro prints the NEXT tithi name instead of repeating the sunrise tithi, so hp_display_ne differs from name_ne by one tithi; Ashesh prints the repeated sunrise tithi, which matches name_ne. Note Hamro Patro spells tritiya as 'तृतिया' (not 'तृतीया'). Coverage: 275 days, full months 2081 Ashar/Shrawan/Bhadra, 2082 Poush/Magh/Falgun, 2083 Bhadra/Asoj/Kartik, every day read from both sources. Disagreements between Hamro Patro sunrise tithi and Ashesh: 2 -> 2081-03-21 (2024-07-05): Hamro Patro sunrise tithi औंसी (paksha_tithi 15) vs Ashesh Chaturdashi (14); 2081-03-24 (2024-07-08): Hamro Patro sunrise tithi तृतिया (paksha_tithi 3) vs Ashesh Dwitiya (2). Comparing Hamro Patro's DISPLAYED name with Ashesh instead gives 21 disagreements (the 19 hp_tithi_shifted days plus these 2). Ashesh shows no paksha; agreement is checked on the 1-15 index. The 'sankranti' list is taken from Hamro Patro event titles for every BS month whose day 1 appeared in the downloaded pages (2081 Ashar-Ashwin, 2081 Chaitra, 2082 Baishakh-Jestha, 2082 Bhadra-Chaitra, 2083 Baishakh, 2083 Bhadra-Poush); months not downloaded are simply absent, not missing from the source. Every sankranti found falls on day 1 of the BS month.
